correctness.rationale: Verified a continuous equivariant positive-part barycentric strong retraction from unordered collision-free continuous graph configurations to unordered pairs of disjoint closed cubical cells: difference under homotopy is the nonzero scalar (1−t+t/s)(α−β), and disjoint-support configurations remain fixed. The full cube automorphism group consists of flips and coordinate permutations. By Hamming normalization zero-cell orbits a_r (1..d) and one-cell orbits b_r (1..d−1) form a path; pairs of disjoint edges have either parallel direction with effective dihedral square-parameter group order4 producing p_r triangles (1..d−1) or perpendicular direction with swap order2 producing q_r triangles (1..d−2). Attaching these gives T_d with f=(2d−1,4d−5,2d−3). Each q_r diagonal is free, each p_r c_r-side is then free, remaining leaf edges collapse to the path and then a point. For d>=4 interior path edges are triple-incident, for d2,d3 a disk. Independently enumerated small-dimensional cubical orbit cell types d=2,3,4, agreeing with predicted counts; inspected all-orbit flag and collapse verifier for d2..5. The all-dimensional proof is normal forms, not the finite enumerations.
